purpose: Define what should be achievable before any managed-exit logic distorts the trade.

anchor_levels.definition: Maximum favorable movement reachable by the trade path under the chosen truth model.
Favorable movement captured by the detector without AEE management beyond basic trade existence and friction.
Actual movement captured after AEE and pricing logic.
How much available movement is converted into realized capture.

decision_logic: If total_available_pips is low, investigate market or sample weakness before detector failure.
If entry_only_capture is high and realized_capture is low, classify primary loss as AEE_INTERACTION or SIMULATION.
If both entry_only_capture and realized_capture are low, classify loss upstream at concept form or implementation.
If filtered capture is materially weaker than firehose capture, classify loss at FILTERING.
